house_style: Naturalistic landscape painting for a high school biome atlas: realistic plants true to the named biome and region, a wide eye-level view, natural light, calm, wild land with no buildings or roads. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.
style: One set of ten sibling biome cards: every scene in the same painted style and the same wide eye-level framing, with sky across the top third and the biome's plants clearly readable at a small size.

assets.name: tundra
assets.prompt: Low arctic tundra plain in summer: a flat wide plain of mosses, sedges and cushions of small white and pink flowers, low ground hugging plants with no trees, a pale sky, natural light.

assets.name: boreal
assets.prompt: Larch and spruce taiga on flat land in late summer: tall straight narrow conifers, a mossy floor with low shrubs, soft light.

assets.name: deciduous
assets.prompt: Temperate oak and hickory forest in summer: tall broadleaf trees with full green canopies, sunlight filtering through the leaves onto a leafy forest floor with young saplings.

assets.name: temperate-rain
assets.prompt: Pacific Northwest coast temperate rainforest: giant conifers with massive trunks, sword ferns and moss-covered fallen logs, hanging moss on branches, soft misty light.

assets.name: mediterranean
assets.prompt: Mediterranean shrubland on a sunny hillside in dry summer: dense evergreen shrubs with small leathery gray-green leaves, a few small twisted evergreen oaks, dry golden grass between the shrubs, bright sun.

assets.name: dry-grass
assets.prompt: Dry shortgrass steppe under a big open sky: low tan and green bunch grasses across flat land, distant low hills, late afternoon light.

assets.name: desert
assets.prompt: Sonoran desert: tall saguaro cactus with upturned arms, scattered round creosote bushes, rocky sandy ground, distant rocky mountains, clear blue sky.

assets.name: trop-savanna
assets.prompt: Miombo woodland savanna in southern Africa in the dry season: scattered broadleaf trees with wide spreading crowns standing above tall golden grass, warm hazy dry season light.
assets.sd: Miombo woodland in Zambia in the dry season: an open woodland of medium-height broadleaf trees with rounded spreading crowns of small feathery leaflets, some crowns turning copper-red and bronze with new leaves, the trees standing well apart above tall golden dry grass on flat land, warm hazy light.

assets.name: trop-seasonal
assets.prompt: West African semi-deciduous tropical forest in the dry season: tall broadleaf trees, some with bare leafless crowns among others still green, a thinner understory, dry hazy light.

assets.name: trop-rain
assets.prompt: Amazon rainforest seen from a calm brown river bank: a dense layered green canopy of many tall broadleaf trees, palms and hanging vines along the water's edge, warm humid light.
